_note: Same three chat models as configs/external_models.json's chat entries, but called directly on CommandCode's provider API instead of through Cloudflare AI Gateway. 'api' selects the wire format: 'messages' = Anthropic shape (premium/Claude models are served only there), 'chat' = OpenAI chat completions. The provider's own /provider/v1/models list reports supported_endpoints per model, so check it before adding one here. Labels match the Cloudflare roster on purpose, so the two transports can be compared row-for-row and rescored on their common successful records.
